claims.explanation: The municipal register (S1) directly records that Pinehaven received exactly 173 water pumps on 18 September 2025, supporting the claim as an event. However, an independent port register (S2) contradicts this by stating Pinehaven received 204 water pumps on the same date, indicating conflicting records about the quantity received.
claims.missing: Independent verification or reconciliation of the conflicting records to confirm the exact number of water pumps received on that date.
